summary: FOR SALE VIA MODERN METHOD OF AUCTION Situated within easy reach of Hartlepool Town Centre, transport links, and a host of local amenities including shops, schools, cafes, and leisure facilities, this two-bedroom mid-terrace property offers an excellent opportunity for a range of buyers—from first-time homeowners to investors.
description:
This property is for sale by the Modern Method of Auction, meaning the buyer and seller are to Complete within 56 days (the "Reservation Period"). Interested parties personal data will be shared with the Auctioneer (iamsold). If considering buying with a mortgage, inspect and consider the property carefully with your lender before bidding. A Buyer Information Pack is provided. The winning bidder will pay £349.00 including VAT for this pack which you must view before bidding. The buyer signs a Reservation Agreement and makes payment of a non-refundable Reservation Fee of 4.5% of the purchase price including VAT, subject to a minimum of £6,600.00 including VAT. This is paid to reserve the property to the buyer during the Reservation Period and is paid in addition to the purchase price. This is considered within calculations for Stamp Duty Land Tax. Services may be recommended by the Agent or Auctioneer in which they will receive payment from the service provider if the service is taken. Payment varies but will be no more than £450.00. These services are optional.

ENTRANCE Access to the property is gained via a UPVC-framed double-glazed door, providing security and allowing natural light to enter the entrance lobby.

LOUNGE

This spacious lounge benefits from high ceilings that enhance the sense of space and light. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window floods the room with natural light, while a central radiator ensures warmth throughout the year. The room's focal point is a charming feature fire surround with inset and hearth, adding character and a cosy atmosphere. Decorative picture rails and ceiling coving further enhance the living area.

DINING ROOM The dining room features a UPVC-framed double-glazed window that allows plenty of natural light to brighten the space. A central radiator ensures comfort, while ceiling coving complements the room's traditional character-perfect for family meals or entertaining guests.

KITCHEN The kitchen is fitted with a range of fitted base and wall units, complemented by durable laminate work surfaces. An inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap provides practical functionality, while tiled splashbacks protect the surrounding walls. Integrated appliances include an oven and hob, with plumbing conveniently provided for an automatic washing machine. Natural light floods the space through a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, and a UPVC door offers direct access to the rear courtyard, seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor living.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The landing provides convenient access to both bedrooms and the family bathroom, serving as a central hub on the first floor and allowing easy movement between rooms.

BEDROOM ONE Bedroom One is a good size double room and features a UPVC-framed double-glazed window that fills the room with natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere. A central radiator ensures the space remains warm and comfortable throughout the year.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom Two is a good-sized room featuring a UPVC-framed double-glazed window that allows plenty of natural light to brighten the space. A central radiator provides warmth, making this bedroom comfortable and versatile.

FAMILY BATHROOM The bathroom boasts a fitted white suite comprising a panelled bath with an electric shower overhead, a wash hand basin, and a WC. Tiling to splash and vanity areas adds a practical and stylish finish. A central radiator provides warmth, while a UPVC-framed double-glazed window offers natural light and ventilation.

EXTERNALLY To the rear, the property benefits from a fully enclosed courtyard, offering a private and secure outdoor space. This area is ideal for outdoor seating, relaxing, or entertaining in a low-maintenance setting.
